headline: Architecture landed — bright facades, varied massing, landmark towers
note: The facade defect is fixed: walls now read as lit stucco with framed windows, and the skyline has real silhouette variety. Streets and Coastline are still building. Two infrastructure bugs were found and fixed this wave — a stale web server was serving old code to screenshots, and the capture harness was aborting on slow frames. Both would have quietly corrupted the review loop.
